classification.difficultyReason: Form parallel-angle equations, first with alternate expressions and then with a reflex complement.

spec.description: Descending transversal with a down-left ray at its left junction and a full steep line at its right junction. Retain both terminal arrowheads and add the approved separate matching interior parallel marks. Two unfilled angle arcs retain labels without degree symbols.
spec.mathematics: The two steep arms are parallel following the approved editorial clarification. The marked alternate interior angles give 5x = x + 64.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 5x and x + 64 are visible in the question.

answer.worked:
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}5x&=x+64\\4x&=64\\x&=16\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled quadrilateral with matching left-pointing parallel marks on its upper and lower sides. The upper-left interior angle is 2x; the lower-left exterior reflex angle is 11x. No vertex names are printed.
spec.mathematics: Parallel upper and lower sides. The upper-left interior angle is 40 degrees and the lower-left interior angle is 140 degrees when x = 20 degrees; its reflex exterior angle is 220 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 2x and 11x appear in the question.

answer.worked:
The lower-left interior angle is $360^\circ-11x$ (angles at a point). Co-interior angles on parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}2x+(360^\circ-11x)&=180^\circ\\-9x&=-180^\circ\\x&=20^\circ\end{align*}$$
